title: Causality and Kinematic Space
purpose: Build kinematic space from causal order and Lorentzian geometry, then connect its regional geometry to information-theoretic observables.
audience: Curious adults prepared to learn definitions and follow constructions; no presumed specialist credential.

competencies.statement: Represent causal comparability as a partial order without smuggling in metric distance.
Use light cones, timelike separation, and causal diamonds correctly.
Construct points or regions of kinematic space from intervals or geodesics.
Interpret geometry on a space whose points represent regions or intervals.
Relate geometric quantities to information or entropy without overstating the correspondence.
Work examples, locate failure cases, and distinguish established results from open questions.

lessons.title: Order before distance
lessons.promise: See how events, partial orders, and causal comparability can carry structure before a metric is chosen.

lessons.title: Lorentzian geometry
lessons.promise: Read light cones, timelike separation, and causal diamonds as the geometry of possible influence.

lessons.title: From intervals to points
lessons.promise: Construct kinematic space by treating intervals or geodesics as its points.

lessons.title: Geometry on a space of regions
lessons.promise: Explore what distance, adjacency, and curvature can mean when every point represents an extended region.

lessons.title: Information, entropy, and kinematic geometry
lessons.promise: Understand what information-theoretic quantities kinematic geometry can measure and where the analogy stops.

lessons.title: Worked constructions, failure cases, and open questions
lessons.promise: Test the framework on examples, diagnose failure cases, and separate current knowledge from research opportunities.

assessmentLaw.completion: Every competency must be demonstrated in a resolvable exercise; watching or playlist membership is not completion.
assessmentLaw.negativeControl: At least one exercise must expose an invalid inference from causal order to metric distance.

successorRule: Material changes create a new revision that names this revision; admitted lesson products remain immutable evidence.
